supporting.title: Wake up at the same time each day

days.title: Dim the lights and wind down for {minutes} minutes before bed
days.reason: A calm wind-down tells your body it is almost time to sleep.

days.title: Read a paper book for {minutes} minutes in bed
days.reason: Reading away from screens can help you relax.

days.title: Take {minutes} minutes to write down tomorrow’s to-do list
days.reason: Getting tasks out of your head can make it easier to fall asleep.

days.title: Do slow breathing for {minutes} minutes before bed
days.reason: Slow breaths help your body settle.

days.title: Get {minutes} minutes of daylight in the morning
days.reason: Morning light helps set your body clock.

days.title: Make your bedroom cool and dark, then rest for {minutes} minutes
days.reason: A cool, dark room is easier to sleep in.

days.title: Stop caffeine after lunch and wind down for {minutes} minutes tonight
days.reason: Less caffeine later in the day can help you sleep.
